evals.prompt: Verify this branch before I merge. I changed the orders API handler and bumped one dependency in package.json.
evals.expected_output: Runs validation in order lint, types, targeted tests, broader tests if risky, build, and a security check because dependencies changed. Signal-first PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL verdict.
assertions: First line is a verdict: PASS, FAIL or PARTIAL
Gates run in order: lint/static, type check, targeted tests before broader tests
Security check is included because a dependency changed
Only gates with signal (failures, warnings, skipped-but-required) are listed; clean gates are not enumerated one by one

evals.prompt: Run checks on this commit again before the handoff. CI already finished fully green on this exact SHA a few minutes ago.
evals.expected_output: State-check first: recent CI on the same SHA is fully green on all required gates, so log 'already verified at <SHA>, skipping' and stop.
assertions: Performs the state-check before running anything
Logs that it is already verified at the SHA and skips re-running
Does not re-run lint, type checks or tests when code has not changed since the green run

evals.prompt: Help me brainstorm what features the onboarding flow should have.
evals.expected_output: No validation run. This is ideation, not pre-merge or pre-release checking.
assertions: Does not run lint, type checks or tests
Engages with the onboarding ideation request
